summary: Runtime dependency sourced from unpinned third-party GitHub branch
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` with source `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node`, with no commit SHA, tag, or version pin. `npm install` resolves this to whatever currently sits at the default branch HEAD of that third-party GitHub repository and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in those bytes. The GitHub account `tenka-san` does not match this package's npm publisher `ikyerza`, and the fetched tree is integrity-unchecked and mutable at any time by that account. The ping/GET pattern flagged in lib/Utils/generics.js is a connectivity/keepalive helper and not independently exfiltration-shaped.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
